references.context: Use Roll & Collect to move around the board and start qualified features.
references.label: Roll & Collect saucer
references.description: Roll the dice, collect property, and start qualified corner or final features here.

references.context: Lock two balls at the center ramp.
references.label: Center ramp and Bank door
references.description: Pass the Bank door to lock balls for Monopoly Multiball.

references.context: Start Monopoly Multiball and advance Land Grab properties at the right ramp.
references.label: Right ramp
references.description: Start Monopoly Multiball; during Land Grab, advance to the next property.

references.context: Shoot the upper-flipper Free Parking ramp for Monopoly Multiball Jackpots.
references.label: Free Parking ramp
references.description: Collect Monopoly Multiball Jackpots or add one Land Grab house per shot until four are complete.

references.context: Shoot the railroad ramp to relight the Monopoly Jackpot.
references.label: Railroad ramp
references.description: Relight Monopoly Jackpots and collect Railroad Multiball Jackpots.

references.context: Shoot Electric Company for the Monopoly Super Jackpot or a Land Grab hotel.
references.label: Electric Company
references.description: Collect the Monopoly Super Jackpot or build a Land Grab hotel.
